div.head: Hn mon 2
div.ab: Et si quis cum falso denario inventus fuerit, si warant inde revocaverit, ad eum ducatur, et si illum inde conprobare poterit, fiat iusticia mea de ipso warant.

And if anyone has been discovered with false money, and has vouched a warrantor for it, the prosecution shall be directed against the latter, and if he [the original defendant] succeeds in proving him guilty, justice in accordance with my laws shall be executed upon the warrantor himself.
